purpose: Adopted committed-source coverage, execution provenance and no-growth size enforcement for 140 legacy application files, the extracted curve kernel, project-document/project-entry integration, the opacity application MCP slice, the staged N13 native viewport metadata adapter, the active N15 native application v2 adapter, the N16 Tauri/MCP v2 host transport, the active N17 native opacity editor/selection intent adapters, the active N18 native opacity preview/export consumers, the active N19C native edit guard, and the bounded N20 native opacity contract/lifecycle/operations/bootstrap cutover. Complete architecture boundaries remain a separate gate. N19G adds pure Motion hit and native-only Select canvas intent adapters. T08B adds the native diagnostics panel query adapter. T10 adds explicit native catalog reproduction UI binding. P37B adds native-safe tutorial UI placement without a document writer. P37A adds an uncovered native History UI column. N25E4A registered the private object Save As coordinator and N25E4B1A the saved-UI acknowledgement helper; P37C1-DESKTOP stage 2 now loads both with three ordinary native project/reference adapters before their consumers, without claiming installed workflow or visible reference acceptance. N25E4B0D fences direct desktop autosave admission through the existing native-opacity project entry. N20R-O2A pins the existing native-opacity lifecycle, preview and viewport receipt-correlation source against the committed inventory. N20R-O2B pins the ordinary Play publication observer hooks in Motion, app and timeline source. P39B1 pins a private inactive-project entry helper without a production loader or visible B tab. N20R-O2C pins passive rejected-error correlation in the existing native Play observer without changing product control flow. P39B pins the ordinary desktop Open routing and inactive token-backed B tab row without activating B. N20R-OBS4 pins passive original-failure to restoration receipt, paint and input correlation, including fail-closed work/view and superseding-intent checks, without changing product navigation or recovery control. P38N5 adds the native inactive-project tab adapter and pins its exact bootstrap order and project/tab request controls. W02-VIS-BRIDGE pins native-owned layer visibility metadata and queued UID-targeted intent in the existing project adapters without claiming an ordinary eye caller, public API/MCP availability or installed acceptance. W02-OBJ-SUB pins common object revision subscription, exact UI/preview before ACK, and queued stable-UID toggle intents; public SDK/catalog activation and installed acceptance remain separate. W02-VIS-EYE routes the ordinary timeline eye through the stable native layer UID without legacy fallback; public capability activation and installed acceptance remain separate. W02-OBJ-SDK admits strict shared v2 object queries and visibility receipts with opaque UID preservation and complete pinned reply correlation; catalog execution and installed acceptance remain separate. W12-START-BIND moves remaining start-screen presence and action wiring into the existing presentation adapter; storage, autosave bytes and guarded native admission/publication remain controller-owned. W02-NATIVE-UI registers private native metadata presentation with existing visibility/Reference consumers, checked frame-only DOM caching and explicit unavailable timing/drawing properties. Source registration leaves full UI/API/MCP/installed capability acceptance open. W02 callback correction supplies explicit projection readiness, live current-session, selection and repaint callbacks from the composition caller; the UI resolves no concrete Project/File provider. Existing private native authority and all capability limitations remain unchanged. D35/#2099 pins the shared native-application SDK property-metadata query wrapper against actual committed source; no production Motion consumer, installed acceptance or full U parity is established by this registration. F06/#2147 registers the ordinary native project-metadata parser and lock/shy UI ports with native-owned prepared/history/public command plumbing; source registration does not establish installed lock/shy, full layer-family parity or final remediation acceptance.

scope.selection: Recursively enumerate committed paths beneath sourceRoot independently of profiles and this artifact, selecting exact case-sensitive suffixes in sourceKinds. Include .d.ts under .ts. Require regular files and reject aliases/symlinks rather than silently skipping them.
scope.pathConvention: Normalized repository-relative POSIX paths. Exact case-sensitive exclusions only: no globs, directory exemptions or inferred vendor/minified/generated exclusions.
scope.typeScript: The four current .ts matches are generated .d.ts declarations, each explicitly excluded. TS selection declares coverage responsibility, not checker parser support.
scope.outsideSelection: HTML is pinned as bootstrap evidence, including its inline script. CSS, JSON/package metadata, WASM binaries, other assets, Rust and sources outside src are outside this JS-family inventory. Imported network/plugin payloads are not committed source files.

inventoryDigest.serialization: Ascending POSIX path order; UTF-8 path + NUL + Git blob SHA-1 + LF for each selected path, including final LF; hash the concatenated bytes.
